title: Yadda apps ke magana: buƙatun, lambobin matsayi da JSON

say: Yadda apps ke magana: buƙatun, lambobin matsayi, da JSON.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module ɗaya na API Fundamentals.
API ɗin, gajeriyar Interface Programming Interface, ƙayyadaddun ƙa'idodi ne da aka buga wanda ke ba da damar shirin ya tambayi wani don bayanai ko aiki.
Abokin ciniki shine shirin da ke tambaya, kamar aikace-aikacen waya. Sabar ita ce kwamfutar da ke amsawa.

say: Tambayar ita ce kira, kuma amsar ita ce amsa. Yawancin APIs na yanar gizo suna amfani da HTTPS, amintaccen yaren da mai binciken ku ke amfani da shi.

say: Kowace bukata tana da hanya, fi’ili. SAMU kwafi. PUT yana maye gurbin abu gaba ɗaya, PATCH yana canza wasu filaye, kuma DELETE yana cire ɗaya.
GET yana da lafiya: karantawa kawai, don haka ba zai iya cutar da komai ba.

panel.heading: Amintacce don maimaita, ko a'a?
left: Ba ya canza komai akan sabar
Yana da kyau don gwadawa a cikin mai bincike
right: Aika sau biyu na iya haifar da biyu

say: POST yana aika sabbin bayanai, kamar fara biyan kuɗi. Ba shi da lafiya a maimaita. Idan POST yana da alama yana rataye, kar a sake latsa aikawa. Kuna iya ƙirƙirar biyan kuɗi biyu. Da farko a duba, ta yin amfani da bayanin ma'amala, ko na farko ya shiga.
